zh: 这一版专门解决「一打开就是白屏、什么也没有」的问题。现在如果启动过程中出了错，屏幕上会直接写明卡在哪一步、错在哪里，还可以长按选中复制或截图发给我们，而不是让你对着一张白纸猜。同时修掉了一处隐患：早先应用需要一个可写的数据目录才能启动，万一系统不给，就会在画第一帧之前静默失败；现在它会自动退到可写的位置继续启动，最坏情况是可能丢失新写入的内容，也不会让你打不开应用。另外，安卓的启动画面原本是一块纯白，现在换成了应用自己的石框色，冷启动时不再闪一下白，即使真的卡住，看上去也仍然像这个应用。
en: This release is about the blank screen: opening the app and getting nothing but white. If the app fails while starting, it now says so on screen — which step it stopped at and what went wrong — and the details can be long-pressed, copied, or screenshotted to send back, instead of leaving you staring at an empty page. It also removes a way for the app to fail silently: starting used to require a writable data folder, and if the system refused one the app died before drawing its first frame. It now falls back to a writable location and keeps going; the worst case is losing newly written data, never being unable to open the app. Finally, the Android launch screen was a plain white rectangle and is now the app's own stone frame, so a cold start no longer flashes white — and a genuine stall at least still looks like this app.
